en.topic_title: Wang Fuk Court administrator to host owners’ meeting across 4 venues via live broadcast
en.topic_summary:
The administrator of the fire-ravaged Wang Fuk Court housing estate will host a special owners’ meeting on July 19 at four different venues, after a months-long wait.



Wang Fuk Court seen in the distance on April 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Hop On Management said on Saturday that it would hold a special homeowners’ meeting “simultaneously” at 11am on July 19 via live broadcast at four locations “to facilitate attendance,” as owners are now resettled i
